title: Adopted DIO time remains trusted after signer key generation is retired
description: Fresh final timing security review: DioTimeVerifier-issued samples store a signer_key_generation token, but _SampleAuthority.accepts and StratumTracker _bound/_rejection never revalidate that token against the receiving LinkLayer. After a valid network time sample is adopted, authenticated rekey/retirement removes the DIO issuance yet current_time/status continue using the retired-key time until ordinary sample expiry. Bind network sample liveness to the LinkLayer current signer generation and revalidate on adoption and every active-source read/policy transition; key rotation must immediately clear the source while preserving replay/correction barriers. Test rotate before adoption, rotate after adoption, status/current_time, same-key refresh, unrelated-peer rotation, and forced concurrency.
